replication.target_description: Okobia et al., DOI 10.1002/pros.21320: overall rs1447295 A-carriage/prostate-cancer association in Afro-Caribbean Tobago men, Table I; final genotyped case–control sample. Original-country descriptions identify the original study populations, not separate replication samples.

n.sample_role: Individual men in the overall rs1447295 case–control analysis: 354 prostate-cancer cases plus 438 non-case controls; not alleles, observations per allele, or an early-onset subgroup.
n.exclusions: Excluded elevated PSA/abnormal DRE without biopsy or with normal biopsy; prostate cancer before enrollment; restricted to men reporting three or four African-descent grandparents. Non-cases had PSA ≤4 ng/ml and normal DRE. The Results explicitly identify successful rs1447295 genotyping in the final case and control groups. No additional model-specific exclusions are stated.
n.location: Results, Association of Chromosome 8q24 SNPrs1447295 (Region1) and Prostate Cancer Risk (canonical line 93); Table I, rs1447295 panel (canonical line 303); Methods, Case–Control Status
n.quote: Men with elevated PSA or abnormal digital rectal exam who had not undergone biopsy, or for whom biopsy results were normal, were excluded from these analyses in order to avoid possible misclassification of men with occult prostate cancer. All males with a prostate cancer diagnosis prior to study enrollment were excluded. Due to the small number of men of non-African descent, these analyses were limited to men who reported that three or four grandparents were of African descent. ... The genotyping assays for chromosome 8q24 SNP rs1447295 were successful in 354 cases and 438 controls. ... Cases (n = 354)	Controls (n = 438)

notes: Identity checked independently: exact article title, all five authors (Okobia, Zmuda, Ferrell, Patrick, Bunker), DOI 10.1002/pros.21320, volume 71, issue 10 and pages 1054–1063 agree with ref_r. The supplied text is a PMC BioC primary research article parse with Methods, Results and Tables I–V, not an abstract-only or secondary article. Header year=2015 differs from the supplied 2011 reference; this archive/header dating discrepancy does not change the exact DOI/title/author match. No PDF was supplied. Only n_r is assigned. Replication mapping uses ref_r, SNP rs1447295, overall outcome and Table I, not row order, numeric agreement, or an assumed replication geography. The four original population descriptions do not create four Tobago replication subgroups. Table III contains secondary summaries of other studies; those counts are not substituted for the primary Tobago Table I analysis. Analytic participant N derivation: 354 cases + 438 controls = 792. Cases and non-cases are explicitly mutually exclusive final groups for rs1447295. This is not a df-based inference or an effect-size conversion. The separate Table II early-onset subgroup is outside the supplied Table I locator. Other statistics and the original side are unassigned placeholders.
